basic_details.job_title: NABARD Recruitment 2026 Notification Out – Apply Online for 24 Junior Project Associate, Senior Project Associate Posts
basic_details.short_information: The National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD), an all-India apex organization wholly owned by the Government of India, has invited online applications under Advertisement No. 05 for 24 Specialists on contract: 21 Junior Project Associates (₹75,000 - ₹1,00,000) and 3 Senior Project Associates (₹1,25,000 - ₹1,50,000). The essential qualification is a graduate degree in Agriculture with at least 55% marks in aggregate. Applications are accepted only online on www.nabard.org from 21.11.2026 to 07.12.2026.

age_limit.details: The age limit for both Junior Project Associate and Senior Project Associate is 24 - 45 years, as on 01.10.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only online on www.nabard.org; no other mode is accepted. Registration and payment of fees/intimation charges run from 21.11.2026 to 07.12.2026.
Visit www.nabard.org and, under Career Notices, click "APPLY HERE" below this recruitment advertisement.
Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter name, contact details and email ID. Note down the Provisional Registration Number and Password shown on screen; they are also sent by email and SMS.
Fill in the application form. "SAVE AND NEXT" lets you save and verify the details; the name must be spelt as in certificates, mark sheets and identity proof.

Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration, capture the live photograph by webcam or mobile phone, and upload the latest C.V./Resume and proof of current Cost to Company in PDF.
Click "Preview" to check the form, then click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION". No change is possible after this.
Click the "Payment" tab and pay the fee and intimation charges online. Wait for the server's response and do not press back or refresh.
Check that an e-Receipt is generated (no e-Receipt means payment failure) and take a printout of the e-Receipt and the application form.

*Exclusive of applicable GST. The fee is non-refundable. Payment can be made by Debit Card (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, or Cash Card/Mobile Wallet. Bank transaction charges are borne by the candidate.
Photograph, 4.5cm × 3.5cm: recent passport-style colour picture, 200 x 230 pixels preferred, file size 20-50 KB
Signature in black ink on white paper: 140 x 60 pixels preferred, file size 10-20 KB
Left thumb impression on white paper with black or blue ink: jpg/jpeg, 240 x 240 pixels, file size 20-50 KB (right thumb may be used if the candidate has no left thumb)
Handwritten declaration in English on white paper with black ink: jpg/jpeg, 800 x 400 pixels, file size 50-100 KB; capital letters are not accepted
Latest C.V./Resume and proof of current Cost to Company: PDF, file size 500 KB

The declaration text is: "I, ____ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." It must be in the candidate's own handwriting. Visually impaired candidates who cannot write may get it typed and put their left-hand thumb impression below it. A declaration written by someone else or in another language makes the application invalid.
important_instructions: NABARD admits candidates on the basis of the information in the online application and verifies eligibility at the stage of interview / joining. Candidature is cancelled if information is false or incorrect, or if the candidate does not satisfy the eligibility criteria according to the Bank. Keep a valid personal email ID and mobile number active until the recruitment process is complete. If the photo and signature are not uploaded at their proper places, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the interview. An unclear or smudged photograph, signature, thumb impression or declaration may lead to rejection. Contract terms: either side may end the engagement by giving one month's notice, and the Bank may terminate at any time without prior notice. If the notice period is not served, the Specialist pays a sum equal to the pay for the notice period. Leave is a maximum of 30 days per calendar year on a proportionate basis, and un-availed leave is not carried forward. Total absence cannot exceed 10 days at any point except on emergency medical grounds with a medical certificate. Quarters may be allotted on request, subject to availability, against a licence fee of 0.5% of remuneration. If quarters are not allotted, a fixed HRA of 10% of remuneration is payable. Travelling and Halting Allowance is payable for official tours as admissible to Bank officers of equivalent grade. Medical facility is for self only, at the Bank's Dispensary wherever available. The Specialist has no right or claim for regular employment or placement in NABARD. Legal proceedings can be instituted only in Mumbai. Any corrigendum will be published only on www.nabard.org. For problems with the form or fee payment, complaints may be made at https://cgrs.ibps.in/ with "NABARD – Recruitment to the post of Specialists on contract" in the email subject.

Junior Project Associate ₹75,000 - ₹1,00,000; Senior Project Associate ₹1,25,000 - ₹1,50,000 (consolidated, all inclusive)

content_sections.heading: About NABARD
content_sections.text: NABARD describes itself in this notice as an all-India apex organization, wholly owned by the Government of India and an equal opportunity employer. Its Head Office is at Plot No, C-24, G Block, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra (E), Mumbai 400051. This is a contract engagement of Specialists for the Head Office and Regional Offices, and the notice is issued by the Chief General Manager, HRMD, Head Office, Mumbai.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 24 vacancies in total: 21 Junior Project Associate posts (one in each of 21 states) and 3 Senior Project Associate posts at the Head Office, Mumbai. All 24 are shown under UR; the SC, ST, OBC and EWS columns are 0. Place of posting is Mumbai and the 21 Regional Offices of NABARD shown in the table, based on project requirements. The Bank reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts, or cancel the recruitment in part or full.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens may apply. Eligibility is counted as on 01.10.2026. Both posts have the same qualification and age limit; the mandatory experience differs. Junior Project Associate: minimum 1-3 years experience in any of the following. Senior Project Associate: minimum 3-5 years experience in any of the same areas. FPO promotion / Farmer collectives Rural development / agri-business project Digital tools of FPO Management The age limit for both Junior Project Associate and Senior Project Associate is 24 - 45 years, as on 01.10.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation.

rows.essential_qualification: Graduate degree in Agriculture with a minimum of 55% marks in aggregate from a University/Institution recognized by the Government of India/UGC. Minimum 1-3 years experience (see below).
rows.desirable: Postgraduate degree or Diploma in Agriculture / Agri-business / Rural Development / Management; experience in Government/PSU/Financial Institutions or marketing of FPO products

rows.essential_qualification: Graduate degree in Agriculture with a minimum of 55% marks in aggregate from a University/Institution recognized by the Government of India/UGC. Minimum 3-5 years experience (see below).
rows.desirable: Postgraduate degree or Diploma in Agriculture / Agri-business / Rural Development / Management; experience in Government/PSU/Financial Institutions or marketing of FPO products

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Specialist is liable for tax as per the Income Tax Act and Rules in force, with tax deducted at source. The amount includes any statutory payments NABARD may have to pay on the Specialist's behalf. An annual increment up to a maximum of 10% can be granted based on satisfactory performance and at the discretion of the Bank. The contract is for 02 years from the date of appointment, extendable for a further period of 03 years. Extension is reviewed one year at a time and will in no case go beyond 05 years. The Specialist is not entitled to any superannuation benefits.

content_sections.heading: NABARD Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints the same key accountabilities (KRAs/KPIs) for both posts, listed separately for each. The Junior Project Associate will support ERP-enabled transformation and strengthening of FPOs through: ERP & Digital Enablement: onboarding FPOs onto ERP platforms; supporting data migration, validation and entry; providing user training and troubleshooting; monitoring adoption and data quality Project Implementation: coordination with CBBOs, FPOs and stakeholders; supporting programme rollout and activities; assisting in training, workshops and exposure visits Monitoring & Evaluation: tracking physical and financial progress; maintaining dashboards and MIS; conducting field visits and validation Compliance & Documentation: supporting claims scrutiny and documentation; tracking statutory and governance compliance Other Responsibilities: capacity building and digital literacy promotion; reporting, analytics and documentation; any other assignments assigned by NABARD The Senior Project Associate will support ERP-enabled transformation and strengthening of FPOs through: ERP & Digital Enablement: onboarding FPOs onto ERP platforms; supporting data migration, validation and entry; providing user training and troubleshooting; monitoring adoption and data quality Project Implementation: coordination with CBBOs, FPOs and stakeholders; supporting programme rollout and activities; assisting in training, workshops and exposure visits Monitoring & Evaluation: tracking physical and financial progress; maintaining dashboards and MIS; conducting field visits and validation Compliance & Documentation: supporting claims scrutiny and documentation; tracking statutory and governance compliance Other Responsibilities: capacity building and digital literacy promotion; reporting, analytics and documentation; any other assignments assigned by NABARD

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted in the ratio of 1:3 based on their qualifications, relevant experience etc. The stages differ by post. Senior Project Associate: Technical Assessment (20 marks) and Interview (80 marks). The Technical Assessment evaluates Excel-based reporting and data analysis, problem-solving and analytical ability, and presentation skills. Junior Project Associate: Interview only (100 marks). Roll numbers of candidates shortlisted for interview will be published on www.nabard.org , and the Bank may send intimation to download call letters through the registered email ID. Final appointment is based on the decision of the Selection Committee. Selected candidates must undergo a pre-recruitment medical examination and are appointed only if declared medically fit by the Bank's Medical Officer. Shortlisted candidates serving in Government/Quasi Government offices, Public Sector Undertakings including Nationalized Banks and Financial Institutions are advised to submit a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the time of interview. Otherwise their candidature may not be considered and any admissible travelling expenses will not be paid. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.text: NABARD reserves the right to change these dates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NABARD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 24 vacancies for Specialists on contract: 21 Junior Project Associates across 21 states and 3 Senior Project Associates at the Head Office, Mumbai. All are shown under the UR category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NABARD Specialist posts?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration and fee payment is 07.12.2026. Applications open on 21.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NABARD Junior and Senior Project Associate?
faq.answer: A graduate degree in Agriculture with a minimum of 55% marks in aggregate from a University/Institution recognized by the Government of India/UGC is required. Junior needs 1-3 years and Senior 3-5 years of mandatory experience in the listed areas.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NABARD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 24 - 45 years for both posts, as on 01.10.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a NABARD Project Associate?
faq.answer: Junior Project Associate gets a consolidated, all-inclusive remuneration of ₹75,000 - ₹1,00,000. Senior Project Associate gets ₹1,25,000 - ₹1,50,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NABARD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: SC/ST/PWBD candidates pay no application fee but Rs. 150 intimation charges. All others pay Rs. 700 plus Rs. 150, a total of Rs. 850. All amounts are exclusive of applicable GST.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for NABARD Specialist recruitment?
faq.answer: Apply only online on www.nabard.org: under Career Notices, click "APPLY HERE" below the advertisement, register, upload the specified documents and pay the fee. No other mode of application is accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NABARD Project Associate?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted in a 1:3 ratio. Senior Project Associate has a Technical Assessment (20 marks) and an Interview (80 marks), while Junior Project Associate has only an Interview (100 marks).

faq.question: Q9. Is the NABARD Specialist job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contract engagement of 02 years, extendable for a further 03 years but not beyond 05 years. The Specialist has no right or claim for regular employment in NABARD.

faq.question: Q10. Is HRA paid on top of the NABARD Project Associate remuneration?
faq.answer: A fixed HRA of 10% of remuneration is payable only if quarters are not allotted. If quarters are allotted, a licence fee of 0.5% of remuneration is payable.
